newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCK TRADE TURNOVER AND PRICES UP IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: STOCK TRADE TURNOVER AND PRICES UP IN MARCH.

text.p: Turnover on the Tallinn stock exchange and the central depository rose by 401.5 million kroons to 1.4 billion kroons in March, the bourse said on Friday.
The TALSE Index rose by 28.2 percent in March to 256.54 points, the bourse said in its newsletter.
The EVK Index, which tracks the Over the Counter (OTC) market, increased by 19 percent to 782.94 points during the month.
Deals made on the stock exchange accounted for 84 percent or 1.26 billion kroons out on the total turnover of Estonian securities market.

The turnover of shares on the exchange was 1.27 billion kroons or 99.7 percent of total bourse turnover. The two official lists accounted for 88.2 percent of trade and the free market for 11.8 percent.
Out of the shares traded on the stock exchange, prices of 12 shares rose and prices of four fell.
The biggest winners were Hoiupank , which gained 41 percent, Uhispank , gaining 34.7 percent and Hansapank , gaining 30.2 percent.
The biggest losers were Estiko , falling 16.1 percent, Saku Brewery , falling six percent and EVEA Pank, falling 5.6 percent.
